name: Jaipur Robotics
notes: Private Swiss startup (Manno, Ticino), founded 2024 by Ermes Zamboni and Nikhil Prakash; not listed, so no market cap. Team of 40 across two R&D centres in Switzerland and Asia, stated Sept 2026 in the seed-round announcement by lead investor High-Tech Gruenderfonds. Not the Indian company the name suggests.

name: JioHotstar
notes: Indian streaming JV of Reliance (Viacom18) and Disney Star, operating as JioStar; not separately listed, so no market cap. No company-stated headcount found: public estimates range from 2236 (EPFO filing for JioStar India Pvt Ltd, April 2024, pre-merger) to 4779 (Revelio Labs, March 2026) to 5525, and JioStar cut about 1100 roles post-merger. Left blank rather than pick among unsourced estimates.

name: Komatsu
notes: Komatsu Ltd (6301.T). Market cap JPY 6.59 trillion on 2026-09-08 per stockanalysis.com, converted at 154.00 JPY/USD (rate on 2026-09-08) = USD 42.79B; companiesmarketcap.com independently reports USD 43.08B for September 2026, a 0.7 percent difference. Headcount 67279 consolidated per Komatsu's own company profile page, dated April 1 2026.

name: LG
notes: Figures cover LG ELECTRONICS INC (066570.KS), not LG Corp, LG Energy Solution, LG Display or LG Chem. Market cap KRW 34.54 trillion on 2026-09-08 per stockanalysis.com, converted at 1342.87 KRW/USD (rate on 2026-09-08) = USD 25.72B. companiesmarketcap.com reports USD 27.56B for September 2026; the roughly 7 percent gap likely reflects inclusion of preferred shares, and the common-share figure is used here. Headcount 75000-plus per LG Electronics' own corporate information page, citing its FY2024 annual report, so the headcount is about 18 months older than the market cap.

name: Micron
notes: Micron Technology Inc (MU). Market cap USD 1.13 trillion on 2026-09-08 per stockanalysis.com. Headcount 53000 as of 2025-08-28 per the FY2025 Form 10-K, up from 48000 a year earlier.

name: Nemetschek
notes: Nemetschek SE (NEM.DE), the parent group, not the Allplan, Bluebeam or Graphisoft brands. Market cap EUR 7.11B on 2026-09-08 per stockanalysis.com, converted at 1.1630 USD/EUR (rate on 2026-09-08) = USD 8.27B; companiesmarketcap.com independently reports USD 8.26B for September 2026. Headcount 4061 as of 2025-12-31 per the 2025 Annual Report, Note 29 Other information (average headcount for 2025 was 4022).

name: Nio
notes: NIO Inc (NIO), whole company across share classes. Market cap USD 9.49B on 2026-09-08, the same figure from stockanalysis.com and companiesmarketcap.com. Some trackers quote around USD 11.4B for the Class A ADR line alone; the 9.49B whole-company figure is used. Headcount 35032 full-time employees at 2025-12-31 per the FY2025 Form 20-F, down from 45635 a year earlier after the 2025 restructuring.
